# Humanoid Xenomorphs
Humanoid xenomorphs are resistant to pressure differences and have acidic blood. Their unarmed attacks deal slash, blunt, and acid damage.
They take [color=#ffa500]5% more piercing damage[/color], [color=#ffa500]take no cold damage[/color], [color=#ffa500]take 20% more heat damage[/color], and [color=#ffa500]take 25% more electrical damage[/color].
They become hungry more quickly and need to eat more often, by approximately 20%. Xenomorphs do not suffer from suffocation. They cannot wear certain items: hard helmets, hardsuits, or boots other than foot wraps, magboots, and ninja boots. Their blood is a potent poison. Their footprints resemble those of Unathi. Their feet are immune to glass shards.
